messages:
sam: heads-up — starter sample broke on node 18 after the canary. dynamic import resolved to the cjs entry and crashed with 'Cannot use import statement outside a module'.

lin: that's the classic conditional exports mismatch. can you paste the exports from the unpacked tarball?

sam: from the tgz:
```json
"exports": {
  ".": { "require": "./dist/cjs/index.js", "import": "./dist/esm/index.js" },
  "./lib/*": "./dist/lib/*.js"
}
```
notice require appears before import — but we publish via a JSON merger that alphabetizes keys.

harper: Node's resolver doesn't literally read key order, but some older Node versions and tooling treat differing shapes differently; the real problem seems to be our pack omitted the ESM files for the canary. the export map pointed at files that didn't exist.

pack-bot: publish workflow used manifest-merge v2. It normalizes JSON keys and dropped preserveGlobs=true. See pack log: https://ci.internal/pack/890

lin: short fixes: 1) rollback canary; 2) republish ensuring both esm and cjs files are present; 3) change pack tool to use a stable serializer that preserves conditional structure or at least asserts the expected export object.

harper: add CI: unpack tgz and assert exports contains import+require and that the referenced paths exist. also add a lightweight sample smoke test that runs `node -e "await import('@redwood/sdk')"` on node-18 in CI.

ci-bot: job 452 failed: node-18 dynamic import smoke test failed. logs: https://ci.internal/jobs/452

sam: i'll revert the canary and open a PR to add the pack-time checks + sample smoke. also adding a devex doc blurb reminding maintainers to verify pnpm/yarn workspace symlinks and edge bundlers when changing exports.

lin: bonus: consider shipping a small utility in scripts/serialize-exports.js that authors use to emit the export map so we avoid ad-hoc stringify/parse that reorders keys.

harper: sounds good. thanks — ping when PR is up and we can coordinate an announce + release note.
